about: Sentences of the former SDK README that the changelog and the program records cite for a statement; each must stay verbatim in CONTRACTS.md (line breaks aside). Frozen when the README became a quick start; the citing locations are in that lane's validation record.
sentences: Ophiolite SDK — preview contracts, supported client
No production-support or complete open-source release qualification is claimed.
Recovery replays a saved exact request and checks the response.
Direct `client.configure/start/publish` calls are available but are **not recoverable after a process restart**.
| Reads, inspect, options, info, members, results and downloads | Up to three attempts for transient transport/busy responses. |
| Configure, start, upload and publish | Up to three attempts with the same command/body; folders persist them for later recovery. |
| Share with `expected_generation` | Once more with the identical command: returns the applied result, or `IntegrityConflict` if anyone changed the recipients meanwhile. |
| Login, refresh and revoke | Never after an ambiguous request outcome. |
This replaces the audience; it is not an additive invitation.
`expected_generation` is required: since the E7 transition release servers refuse unconditional replacement (428).
Source installation is available; PyPI/npm publication and managed-service release qualification are separate delivery gates.
The SDK, TypeScript client, templates, packaged guides and extracted contracts are Apache-2.0.
Server licensing and the complete open-source release have separate qualification requirements.
